goal: Cross-vendor review of the campaign diff against its spec

taskPacket.objective: Review the campaign change (git diff origin/main..HEAD for the files in readFiles, plus a sample of evals/judge-canary/ and evals/paired/corpus/) against docs/campaigns/evals-with-a-budget/spec/SPEC.md and report defects.
instructions: Read the spec. For each changed file run `git diff origin/main -- <file>` and read it. Sample at least three judge-canary cases of different kinds and one paired corpus entry. Do not modify any file.
For each requirement R1 to R10 say whether the change implements the statement and whether its proof would fail without the implementation. R11 is not implemented yet; skip it.

The purpose of these instruments is numbers that are real and meaningful. Look hardest for anything that would make a reading lie: a budget that can be overrun or reports voided spend as zero, a band computed on too few points, a delivered count that credits an arm for a guard that passes at base, a canary defect a mechanical check would catch or a clean case that is not clean, a recall that counts a rejection without a finding citing the item, a result that cannot be traced to its commit, seed and runtimes, a corpus entry whose proofs pass at base. Also note that the canary was built from only three golden tasks, and say whether that limits what it can measure.
Return output as {findings: [{severity: critical|major|minor, where, defect, scenario}], satisfied: [requirement ids]}. An empty findings list is a valid answer; do not invent defects.
